level.setting: A vast, mysterious underwater world filled with ancient ruins, shifting labyrinths, and dangerous creatures lurking in the deep. The water is murky, and the silence is broken only by the sound of the player's movements and the distant calls of unseen beings.

enemy.name: Corrupted Manta Ray
enemy.weakness: Electric current (from the player's geomantic staff)

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with bioluminescent algae that reduces the player's visibility and movement speed.

pickup.name: Fossilized Ore
pickup.effect: Unlocks a geomantic ability to generate a shockwave when activated.

encounters.trigger: Upon entering the chamber, a strange light pulses from the ancient stone pillars. When the player investigates, the Manta Ray emerges from the shadows.

enemy.name: Lurker Eel
enemy.weakness: Corrosive energy (from the Fossilized Ore pickup)

encounters.hazard: The labyrinth shifts and collapses occasionally, forcing the player to navigate through a maze that changes layout every few seconds.

pickup.name: Ancient Relic Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the path to the final chamber.

encounters.trigger: After retrieving the Fossilized Ore, the player notices a faint hum from deeper in the labyrinth. As they proceed, the eel ambushes them in a narrow passage.

enemy.name: Leviathan Lord
enemy.weakness: Combination of electric shockwave (from geomantic staff) and corrosive energy (from Fossilized Ore)

encounters.hazard: The chamber is unstable, with frequent quakes and collapsing structures. The Leviathan Lord's presence causes the water to churn violently, impairing movement.

pickup.name: Core of the Abyss
pickup.effect: Grants the player permanent energy regeneration and enhances all geomantic abilities.

encounters.trigger: With the Ancient Relic Key in hand, the player unlocks the final chamber. A deep, echoing roar signals the awakening of the Leviathan Lord.

boss.name: Leviathan Lord
boss.weakness: Combination of electric shockwave (from geomantic staff) and corrosive energy (from Fossilized Ore pickup)
boss.victory_condition: Reduce enemy health to 0 using the combined effects of the geomantic staff and Fossilized Ore.

level.objective: Navigate through the mysterious underwater ruins, defeat three enemies, and defeat the Leviathan Lord using abilities unlocked through pickups acquired during the journey.
level.reward: Core of the Abyss (permanent upgrade), access to new geomantic abilities, and a sense of peace after defeating the Leviathan Lord.

level.setting: A tranquil, glowing underwater world filled with bioluminescent coral, schools of fish, and ancient submerged ruins.
level.player_weapon: Tentacle Staff (a long, flexible weapon that can be used to guide and direct the Beastmaster's companion)

encounters.hazard: Mysterious current pulls the player toward the next area.

pickup.name: Coral Charm
pickup.effect: Increases the Beastmaster's companion's attack power by 15%

encounters.trigger: Player swims past a glowing anemone, causing the ray to emerge from the shadows.

encounters.hazard: A mechanical arm extends from the wreckage, trying to grab the player.

pickup.name: Sonar Beacon
pickup.effect: Marks nearby enemies for the Beastmaster's companion to target more effectively

encounters.trigger: The current leads the player to a broken submersible; the turret activates when the player enters its detection range.

encounters.hazard: The Leviathan's presence causes the water to become turbulent and murky, reducing visibility.

pickup.name: Pearl of Calm
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and grants a temporary shield

encounters.trigger: The Sonar Beacon activates upon entry, revealing the Leviathan's location and drawing it to the player.

boss.name: Leviathan of the Deep
boss.weakness: Sonar Beacon (only usable if player has it from prior encounters)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan using the Sonar Beacon to mark its weak spot, then strike with the Tentacle Staff or your companion's bite.

level.objective: Reach the surface by navigating through three serene yet challenging underwater zones, using your Beastmaster companion and collected items to overcome obstacles and enemies.
level.reward: Pearl of Calm and access to the surface world, unlocking new abilities and areas.

level.setting: A desolate, ancient underwater tomb filled with spectral entities, eerie bioluminescent flora, and hidden dangers lurking in the dark.

enemy.name: Soulbound Coral Warden
enemy.weakness: Blade of the Abyss (acquired after this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Tendrils of sentient coral that slowly constrict the player and reduce movement speed.

pickup.name: Blade of the Abyss
pickup.effect: Inflicts 50% more damage against aquatic enemies and reduces their healing effects by 30%.

encounters.trigger: Player awakens ancient ruins and the Warden emerges to guard the path forward.

enemy.name: Wraith Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Soulbound Coral Warden's shattered shell (acquired after first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Maelstrom currents that push the player into dangerous areas and slow attack speed.

pickup.name: Soulbound Coral Warden's shattered shell
pickup.effect: When used in combat, it deals 100 damage to all water-based enemies and reveals hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: Player encounters a massive, ghostly leviathan that is drawn to the Blade of the Abyss, forcing the player into a battle.

enemy.name: The Deep One
enemy.weakness: Soulbound Coral Warden's shattered shell (acquired in second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The chamber fills with toxic water that damages the player over time and reduces stamina regeneration.

pickup.name: Eternal Abyss Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final gate to the Abyssal Core and grants resistance to all underwater hazards for 60 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Deep One, a grotesque fusion of human and aquatic creature, emerges from the depths, drawn by the presence of the Warden's shell.

boss.name: The Deep One
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Deep One and collect the Eternal Abyss Key.

level.objective: Reach the Abyssal Core and unlock the path to the next zone.
level.reward: Access to the Abyssal Core and the ability to summon undead aquatic creatures.

level.setting: A vast, dark underwater labyrinth filled with ancient ruins, toxic currents, and aggressive marine life. The atmosphere is thick with tension, with echoes of the past and the promise of a terrible reckoning.

encounters.hazard: Periodic seismic tremors cause unstable coral to fall.

pickup.name: Electrified Tendrils
pickup.effect: Increases player's lightning damage by 40% for 5 minutes.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the warden, a submerged control panel activates, revealing the path to the next area via a hidden pressure valve.

encounters.hazard: Periodic waves of toxic algae bloom, reducing player stamina.

pickup.name: Tidebinder Amulet
pickup.effect: Reduces incoming water damage by 50% and increases movement speed by 20% in submerged environments.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the spirit, the amulet pulses with energy, revealing the location of the final chamber through a submerged portal.

encounters.hazard: The chamber fills with a corrosive deep-sea current, slowing movement and dealing damage over time.

pickup.name: Abyssal Crown
pickup.effect: Grants temporary immunity to all status effects and increases player health by 20% for 3 minutes.

encounters.trigger: The portal opens, revealing the Sovereign, whose presence triggers a massive tremor that collapses the ceiling, limiting escape routes.

boss.name: The Abyssal Sovereign
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Sovereign and escape through the collapsing ceiling to the surface.

level.objective: Reach the surface by navigating the abyss, defeating three foes and the final boss, using pickups from prior encounters to exploit weaknesses.
level.reward: The Abyssal Crown, granting the player increased survival and combat efficiency, and a permanent ability to summon a brief storm burst in combat.

level.setting: A deep, ancient underwater temple, long forgotten by the world above, now haunted by spectral entities and mutated aquatic creatures.
level.player_weapon: Electrostatic Discharge (primary weapon, emits high voltage pulses)

encounters.hazard: The cavern is filled with shifting coral that can trap the player if not navigated carefully.

pickup.name: Echo Lens
pickup.effect: Enhances vision in dark or murky waters, revealing hidden pathways and enemy locations.

encounters.trigger: Player disrupts the eel's bioluminescent signal by using the Electrostatic Discharge, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: The trench is unstable, with shifting currents and collapsing rock formations that can damage the player.

pickup.name: Pressure Core
pickup.effect: When activated, releases a shockwave that can damage enemies or trigger environmental hazards.

encounters.trigger: Using the Echo Lens, the player locates the Leviathan's heart chamber, which opens the path to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with corrosive water and ghostly echoes that disorient the player.

pickup.name: Abyssal Sigil
pickup.effect: Unlocks new abilities related to shadow manipulation and underwater stealth.

encounters.trigger: The player uses the Pressure Core to destabilize the Guardian's core, revealing its vulnerable heart and initiating the boss fight.

boss.name: Abyssal Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Guardian by activating the Pressure Core on its core, triggering a destabilizing shockwave.

level.objective: Navigate through the haunted underwater ruins, overcome the three guardians, and defeat the Abyssal Guardian to claim the Abyssal Sigil.
level.reward: Abyssal Sigil, granting enhanced shadow abilities and stealth, allowing the player to move undetected through the darkened underwater world.

level.setting: An ancient sunken temple filled with fire vents, lava flows, and collapsing ruins, with chaotic environmental hazards and aggressive enemies.
level.player_weapon: Firebrand Flame Sword (initial weapon, later upgraded with Flame Infusion Core)

encounters.hazard: Periodic lava eruptions from cracks in the ground

pickup.name: Flame Infusion Core
pickup.effect: Increases weapon damage by 40% and adds fire elemental damage

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Coral Golem, the player finds a glowing **Flame Infusion Core**. It automatically upgrades the player's weapon to a fire-based elemental attack. A tremor shakes the ruins, causing a fissure to open, leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing vents and molten rock pillars

pickup.name: Flame Reflector
pickup.effect: Reflects enemy projectiles back at them with 50% power

encounters.trigger: The player must navigate the thermal vent maze while avoiding scalding steam and collapsing rocks. The Pyroshark is drawn by the heat of the player's fire-infused weapon. After defeating it, the player finds a **Flame Reflector**, which can be used to redirect enemy attacks back at them.

encounters.hazard: Explosive fire traps, unstable terrain, and fiery shockwaves

pickup.name: Pyrothor's Heart
pickup.effect: Grants permanent fire resistance and increases fire damage by 60%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Pyroshark, the player reaches the core chamber of the ancient fire god, Pyrothor. The chamber is unstable with violent tremors, and the boss attacks with fire blasts and shockwaves. The player must use the **Flame Reflector** to bounce the boss’s attacks back at it in a timed window during the final phase.

boss.name: Pyrothor
boss.weakness: Flame Reflector (must be used in conjunction with core abilities during final phase)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by reflecting fire attacks back at it with the Flame Reflector

level.objective: Navigate the submerged ruins and defeat the ancient fire god Pyrothor, using fire-based abilities and pickups to overcome increasingly chaotic and dangerous encounters.
level.reward: Pyrothor's Heart - A permanent fire-based power-up that enhances the player's pyro abilities and grants fire resistance.

level.setting: A vast, uncharted ocean floor with remnants of a long-forgotten civilization. The atmosphere is cold and eerie, with bioluminescent creatures and ancient ruins half-buried in sediment.
level.player_weapon: Charged Pulse Rifle (high damage, charged shots, limited ammo)

enemy.name: Coral Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Thermal Shock (from Thermal Grenades pickup found in this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Crushing pressure and unstable coral shards.

pickup.name: Thermal Grenades
pickup.effect: Explodes on impact, causing area thermal damage.

encounters.trigger: Player activates a long-forgotten beacon to stabilize the ruins, causing the Leviathan to awaken.

enemy.name: Phosphor Wraith
enemy.weakness: Electrostatic Discharge (from Warden's primary weapon, the Charged Pulse Rifle)

encounters.hazard: Toxic algae and unpredictable current shifts.

pickup.name: Energy Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases Charged Pulse Rifle's damage by 20% for 60 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Wraith is drawn by the Thermal Grenades' residual energy, emerging from the trench to investigate.

enemy.name: The Leviathan King
enemy.weakness: Combined Thermal and Electrostatic Overload (using Thermal Grenades and Energy Capacitor)

encounters.hazard: Extreme pressure, seismic tremors, and toxic gas vents.

pickup.name: Vault Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ancient vault, revealing a powerful artifact or lore.

encounters.trigger: The Wraith's distress call summons the Leviathan King to the core, where it guards a sealed ancient vault.

boss.name: The Leviathan King
boss.weakness: Thermal Grenades + Energy Capacitor (must be used together for final blow)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan King with combined thermal and electrostatic damage.

level.objective: Reach the ancient vault and retrieve the Vault Key, surviving the brutal encounters along the way.
level.reward: Vault Key, lore about the fallen warden civilization, and a chance to unlock the ancient artifact.

level.setting: Colorful, surreal underwater world filled with glowing corals, shifting illusions, and playful sea creatures that react to the player’s illusions.

enemy.name: Bloop
enemy.weakness: Reflective Mirror Shard (acquired in this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Swirling bubbles cause temporary blindness if not dodged.

pickup.name: Reflective Mirror Shard
pickup.effect: Reflects enemy attacks back at them for 1 round.

encounters.trigger: Player interacts with a glowing coral that releases a bubble containing the Reflective Mirror Shard.

encounters.hazard: Darkness obscures vision unless the player holds the Pearlescent Beacon.

pickup.name: Pearlescent Beacon
pickup.effect: Light source that illuminates hidden paths and reveals invisible enemies.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Reflective Mirror Shard to reflect the Nibbler’s attack, revealing a hidden path through the trench.

encounters.hazard: The environment shifts and warps, making navigation challenging.

pickup.name: Coral Crown of Clarity
pickup.effect: Grants the player a powerful illusionary spell that disorients enemies for 2 rounds.

encounters.trigger: The player shines the Pearlescent Beacon on the Abyssal Illusionist, breaking its illusionary form and revealing its true form.

boss.name: Abyssal Illusionist
boss.victory_condition: Player shines the Pearlescent Beacon on the boss, breaking its illusions and revealing its true form to strike with the Illusionary Wand.

level.objective: Navigate the whimsical underwater realm, collect key artifacts, and defeat the final illusionist boss by using the tools you have acquired along the way.
level.reward: Coral Crown of Clarity (a powerful illusionary spell item that can be used in future levels).

level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle filled with towering trees, glowing flora, and shifting terrain that reacts to the player's presence.
level.player_weapon: Beastmaster Whistle (controls a bonded beast that can distract, heal, or attack)

enemy.name: Vinebound Serpent
enemy.weakness: Player's Beastmaster Whistle (activates the bonded beast to distract)

encounters.hazard: The canopy is unstable; falling debris occasionally damages the player.

pickup.name: Luminous Totem
pickup.effect: Increases beast damage by 25% for the next encounter. Also acts as a beacon for the final boss.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the serpent causes it to drop a 'Luminous Totem' that glows with ancient jungle magic. The totem pulses, drawing the attention of the next encounter.

enemy.name: Crystal Warden
enemy.weakness: The Luminous Totem from the previous encounter, which disrupts its crystalline armor.

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable and collapses in some sections, forcing the player to move quickly.

pickup.name: Echoing Drum
pickup.effect: When used, the player's bonded beast becomes invulnerable for 5 seconds. Also emits a sound that confuses the final boss.

encounters.trigger: After the Warden is defeated, it shatters, revealing a hidden path to the final chamber. A low growl echoes in the distance.

enemy.name: Jungle Sovereign
enemy.weakness: The Echoing Drum from the previous encounter, which disrupts its psychic control over the jungle.

encounters.hazard: The environment is alive—vines attack, ground shifts, and the air is thick with hallucinogenic spores.

pickup.name: Jungle Heart
pickup.effect: Restores all health and grants a temporary power boost to the beastmaster and bonded beast.

encounters.trigger: The Luminous Totem and Echoing Drum both are required to weaken the Sovereign. The boss must be attacked with the bonded beast in the invulnerable state to break its defenses.

boss.name: Jungle Sovereign
boss.weakness: Echoing Drum (only works if the bonded beast is invulnerable, which is only achievable by using the Echoing Drum while in the final fight).
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Sovereign by combining the Luminous Totem and Echoing Drum to break its psychic shield.

level.objective: Survive the jungle and defeat the Jungle Sovereign by utilizing the pickups from prior encounters in the correct sequence.
level.reward: Jungle Heart, granting a permanent boost to health and beast abilities.

level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle filled with glowing vines, hidden paths, and creatures that blend into the shadows. The atmosphere is thick with mystery, and the deeper the player goes, the more the jungle seems alive and aware of their presence.

enemy.name: Veil Spider
enemy.weakness: Silent Shot (player's bow with silent arrows)

encounters.hazard: A mist cloud appears, reducing player visibility by 50% for 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Ancient Jade Amulet
pickup.effect: Increases player's accuracy by 10% and reveals enemy weak points on the map.

encounters.trigger: Player uses Silent Shot to take out the Veil Spider without alerting the jungle. This action causes the ground to shift, revealing a hidden path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Root Warden
enemy.weakness: Ancient Jade Amulet (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: The cave is unstable. Every 20 seconds, a rockslide occurs, blocking the path and forcing the player to find alternate routes.

pickup.name: Cursed Totem
pickup.effect: Temporarily grants the player an ability to slow enemies, but may cause a curse if not used wisely.

encounters.trigger: The player uses the Jade Amulet to detect the weak point of the Root Warden. As the player damages the warden, the ground begins to collapse, forcing the player into a narrow cave system that leads to the final boss.

encounters.hazard: The boss fight is surrounded by a circle of glowing plants that deal damage on contact.

pickup.name: Heart of the Jungle
pickup.effect: Fully restores player health and grants a temporary invincibility shield.

encounters.trigger: After navigating the cave, the player arrives at the heart of the jungle, where the Jungle Guardian stands before a sacred tree. Using the Cursed Totem allows the player to slow the guardian long enough to strike a critical blow.

boss.name: Jungle Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Jungle Guardian using the Cursed Totem to slow it, then deliver the final blow.

level.objective: Reach the Heart of the Jungle and defeat the Jungle Guardian, using pickups and knowledge from previous encounters to overcome challenges.
level.reward: Heart of the Jungle artifact, granting the player full healing and invincibility, along with access to a new area of the jungle.

level.setting: Dense, dark jungle with ancient ruins, toxic mist, and unseen predators. The atmosphere is oppressive and filled with tension.

enemy.name: Vinebound Stalker
enemy.weakness: Blunt force - Player's weapon must be a *Dagger of Rupture* (a pickup from this encounter).

encounters.hazard: Thick vines and swinging logs create a tense atmosphere. Mistakes here could cost the player their health.

pickup.name: Dagger of Rupture
pickup.effect: Deal +15 damage to enemies with a critical strike. Can be used as a weapon or to unlock hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: Player defeats the Stalker and finds a *Dagger of Rupture* hidden in its ribcage. The blade emits a faint glow, revealing a path deeper into the jungle. This is the only way forward.

enemy.name: Cursed Shaman
enemy.weakness: Fire - Player must use the *Dagger of Rupture* to ignite the altar's ceremonial fire.

encounters.hazard: The altar is surrounded by cursed spirits that attack in waves. The player must avoid getting overwhelmed by the shaman’s magic.

pickup.name: Ember Talisman
pickup.effect: Increase fire resistance by 30% and allows the player to ignite nearby objects.

encounters.trigger: The shaman attempts to curse the player with a hex. To break it, the player must light the fire with the *Dagger of Rupture*, which reveals a hidden passage leading to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Jungle Guardian (Boss)
enemy.weakness: The *Ember Talisman* must be used to ignite the boss's heart, which is protected by a layer of toxic jungle mire.

encounters.hazard: The boss has multiple phases, each with increasing difficulty. Toxic spores, shifting terrain, and heavy attacks make this one of the most brutal fights in the game.

pickup.name: Jungle Core
pickup.effect: Restores all health and grants temporary invincibility. Can be sold for a rare resource.

encounters.trigger: The player reaches the Heart of the Jungle, where the Guardian, a massive plant-like being, emerges. It guards the area with vines and toxic spores. The only way to break its defenses is to use the *Ember Talisman* to burn through the mire and expose its core.

boss.name: Jungle Guardian
boss.weakness: Exposure of core via *Ember Talisman* (must be used during the fight).
boss.victory_condition: Player ignites the core using the Ember Talisman, causing the Jungle Guardian to crumble.

level.objective: Survive the jungle’s deadly trials, uncover the secrets of the jungle, and claim the Jungle Core to escape with your life.
level.reward: Jungle Core (healing item), Ember Talisman, and access to hidden jungle routes.

level.setting: A lush, quiet jungle with glowing flora, ancient ruins, and a sense of calm beauty that hides the dangers within.

encounters.hazard: Slippery moss patches reduce movement speed.

pickup.name: Ember Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks fire-based attacks for the player's weapon.

encounters.trigger: Player enters the streamside clearing after following a trail of glowing mushrooms.

encounters.hazard: Moving roots shift the terrain and block paths.

pickup.name: Vine Relic
pickup.effect: Grants immunity to root-based entanglements.

encounters.trigger: Player activates a hidden glyph beneath the canopy, revealing the enemy.

encounters.hazard: Toxic mist appears during the fight, reducing player stamina.

pickup.name: Serenity Amulet
pickup.effect: Reduces damage from all enemies by 20% for the rest of the game.

encounters.trigger: Player uncovers a sealed shrine at the base of a massive tree, which awakens the boss.

boss.name: Jungle Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by using the Vine Relic to bypass entanglement attacks and strike the core.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the jungle and retrieve the Serenity Amulet, restoring balance to the sacred land.
level.reward: Serenity Amulet (boosts player's defense and allows peaceful traversal of jungle zones).

level.setting: A dark, overgrown jungle filled with ancient ruins, glowing fungi, and a sense of oppressive dread. The air is thick with mist and the sound of unseen creatures moving through the shadows.
level.player_weapon: Necrotic Staff (primary) and Bone Mace (secondary, acquired in first encounter)

encounters.hazard: The jungle is thick with mist, reducing visibility and increasing enemy spawns.

pickup.name: Bone Mace
pickup.effect: Increases necrotic damage by 20% and has a chance to slow enemies.

encounters.trigger: The player finds an ancient tomb in the dense undergrowth. As they investigate, a shattered spirit awakens, bound to the tomb. It attacks, trying to stop the player from uncovering the secrets within.

encounters.hazard: The vines react to the player's presence, creating obstacles that close in over time.

pickup.name: Bloodvine Sap
pickup.effect: Can be used to weaken enemies by creating temporary necrotic traps on the ground.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shattered Spirit, the player follows a path marked by glowing vines. The labyrinth begins to shift, trapping the player with a wraith that feeds on the blood of intruders.

enemy.name: The Jungle's Guardian
enemy.weakness: Bone Mace and Bloodvine Sap (both required to weaken)

encounters.hazard: The environment itself attacks—vines whip, toxic fog spreads, and shadows move with unnatural intent.

pickup.name: Elixir of the Forgotten
pickup.effect: Restores full health and grants a temporary immunity to necrotic damage.

encounters.trigger: The player reaches the center of the jungle, where the air is thick with decay and the ground pulses with dark energy. The Jungle's Guardian emerges, a powerful wraith fused with the jungle’s essence. It is the final test of the player's mastery.

boss.name: The Jungle's Guardian
boss.weakness: Bone Mace and Bloodvine Sap (both required to weaken)
boss.victory_condition: Reduce the boss’s health to zero while both pickups are active and used strategically.

level.objective: Uncover the secret of the jungle and defeat the final guardian. Use the pickups acquired in prior encounters to break through the final boss’s defenses.
level.reward: Elixir of the Forgotten and access to a hidden necromancer relic that enhances the player’s summoning abilities.

level.setting: A surreal jungle filled with floating plants, singing crystals, and magical flora. The environment reacts to the player's actions, becoming more whimsical and chaotic as the level progresses.
level.player_weapon: Alchemical Flask (can hold various tinctures, including the Flame-Infused Tincture)

encounters.hazard: The thicket becomes increasingly dense, making movement harder. The player must avoid tripping over roots or falling into hidden pits.

pickup.name: Flame-Infused Tincture
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 20% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Player discovers a glowing plant in the underbrush, which reacts to the player's alchemical tools by releasing a harmless puff of smoke. This triggers the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: The crystals are sensitive to noise, causing sudden bursts of magical energy that may damage the player.

pickup.name: Echo Shard
pickup.effect: Can be used to disrupt enemy magical attacks for a short duration.

encounters.trigger: The player follows the sound of haunting melodies leading to a grove of glowing crystals. The Sylphid appears when the player touches one of the crystals.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is unstable, and the ground may collapse in sections, forcing the player to navigate carefully.

pickup.name: Alchemist’s Seal
pickup.effect: Grants temporary immunity to all status effects and a 50% damage reduction for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sylphid, the player notices a strange pulsating glow beneath the ground. Digging reveals a hidden chamber, and the Mangler emerges.

boss.name: Madcap Mangler
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Echo Shard to disrupt its magic.

level.objective: Defeat the Madcap Mangler, the guardian of the jungle’s alchemical heart, and retrieve the Alchemist’s Seal.
level.reward: Alchemist’s Seal and access to the next level.

level.setting: A dense, overgrown jungle where the trees twist in unnatural ways and the air is thick with an eerie, silent tension. Time seems to warp and stutter as the player moves deeper into the temple, creating an unsettling, dreamlike atmosphere.

encounters.hazard: The ground becomes unstable, forcing the player to navigate shifting platforms to avoid falling into the chasm below.

pickup.name: Time Anchor
pickup.effect: Grants the player 5 seconds of time slowdown when used.

encounters.trigger: Player activates the ancient stone circle, revealing hidden markings that pulse with energy. The ground begins to shift, summoning the Stalkers.

encounters.hazard: The grove is filled with shifting illusions that confuse the player’s sense of direction.

pickup.name: Echo Crystal
pickup.effect: When used, the player can momentarily rewind the last 5 seconds of time, undoing damage or repositioning.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Stalkers, the Time Anchor unlocks a hidden path through the vines. As the player proceeds, the Warden materializes from the roots, its eyes glowing with ancient power.

encounters.hazard: The temple is filled with time loops that replay the player's actions, forcing them to learn the Serpent's attack patterns.

pickup.name: Eternal Hourglass
pickup.effect: Grants the player a permanent time buffer, allowing 10 seconds of time rewind or slowdown at any time.

encounters.trigger: The Echo Crystal activates the ancient temple doors, revealing the boss. The Chrono Serpent coils around the temple pillars, its scales flickering with time energy.

boss.name: The Chrono Serpent
boss.weakness: Echo Crystal (requires the pickup from the Hollow Grove to break the boss's time shield and land critical hits).
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Chrono Serpent using the Echo Crystal to bypass its temporal defenses.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the temple and retrieve the Eternal Hourglass, using time manipulation to survive the jungle's trials.

level.setting: A once-thriving jungle now overgrown and cursed, with no signs of life except for the remnants of a forgotten civilization and the twisted spirits of the jungle.
level.player_weapon: A jagged war hammer, with a reinforced grip for brutal smashing.

encounters.hazard: Toxic Spores drift through the air, reducing player stamina by 15% every 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Ancient Chisel
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new combat ability: 'Split Strike' – allows the player to deal 2x damage on the next hit.

encounters.trigger: The player smashes the cracked stone tablet nearby with their weapon, revealing a hidden passage into the temple.

encounters.hazard: A pack of infected jungle beasts surround the player after the fight, attacking in waves.

pickup.name: Burning Ember
pickup.effect: When equipped, increases fire damage by 50% for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The player uses the 'Split Strike' ability on the Shaman's enchanted staff, causing it to crack and expose a fire core inside.

encounters.hazard: The jungle itself becomes alive, with roots lashing out and summoning shadow beasts.

pickup.name: Eternal Bloom
pickup.effect: Restores all health and grants temporary invincibility for 10 seconds when used.

encounters.trigger: The Shaman’s final words point the player toward the Heart of the Jungle, where the Spirit emerges from the roots of a massive tree.

boss.name: Spirit of the Jungle
boss.weakness: The 'Burning Ember' pickup acquired in the second encounter
boss.victory_condition: Deal 800 damage using the Burning Ember

level.objective: Survive the jungle’s wrath and defeat the Spirit of the Jungle, proving the berserker's fury is unmatched.
level.reward: Eternal Bloom, a legendary item granting invincibility and healing, marking the player as a true master of the jungle’s fury.
